topics.purpose: Define the boundary between canonical internal references and explicitly declared external references so external linkage never masquerades as unresolved internal canonical identity.

semantics.internal_rule: Required internal references resolve exactly once inside the active canonical graph.
semantics.external_rule: External references are valid only when their owning contract explicitly declares the external reference form, resolution semantics and authority boundary.
semantics.unresolved_rule: A reference that is neither a valid internal ref nor a declared external ref is unresolved and becomes a gap.
semantics.authority_rule: External existence does not grant canonical or runtime authority.
semantics.trace_rule: External boundaries preserve provenance and remain visibly external in traces and projections.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant meaning is explicit structured canonical data and is not reconstructed by hidden heuristics.
